caption:
You give. Feels like losing? (1 Timothy 6:17–19)

Riches are an “uncertainty” — time, accidents, and at last death empty every vault. So hope moves to “the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy.” And sharing isn’t losing: it lays up “a good foundation against the time to come.”

Giving buys no salvation. Christ gave Himself as a ransom for all (2:6). We give because we already hold the life He gave.
